chunks: He was asked about reciting poetry—does it nullify wudu (ablution)? So he said: No.

key_terms.إِنْشَادِ: recitation or chanting, here referring to reciting poetry
key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the state of ritual purity

ai.seo_question: Does reciting poetry break wudu in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that reciting poetry does not nullify wudu (ablution). Its significance is in clarifying the limits of what breaks ritual purity in acts of worship.
